title: Chapter 58 Meet The Lord Of The Deserted City
content:
Chapter 58 Meet The Lord Of The Deserted City

At this time, outside the deserted city.

A hot breath hits in the face.

I saw several tall creatures with blazing flames all over their bodies slowly walking towards here.

It is the Fire Spirit Clan, one of the strongest clans in the Ten Thousand Spirits Realm.

It is also the clan with the most fire-based attack methods among all creatures.

Of course, it is just the most, not the strongest.

After all, the dragon breath of the Fire Phoenix Clan and the Dragon Clan is not weaker than that of the Fire Spirit Clan.

"Grand Elder, this, this deserted city seems to be very unusual."

At this time, a member of the Fire Spirit Clan looked at the huge city in front of him and said in shock.

The leader was the great elder of the Fire Spirit Clan.

The great elder nodded solemnly, and then said: "Be more restrained after entering. I feel an extremely terrifying breath in this huge city."

Hearing this, several members of the Fire Spirit Clan were shocked.

Even the great elder said it was extremely terrifying, so what kind of existence must the other party be.

Their great elder is a powerful man of the eighth level of the earth realm.

With a look of doubt, they paid the entrance fee and entered the deserted city.

Soon, another race also came here.

The demon clan.

And it was the demon clan leader who came in person. Although he was alone, his momentum was invincible.

The demon clan leader looked down at the deserted city below, and his expression was also shocked.

He wanted to use a big move to shock the opponent right away, but suddenly hesitated.

Would it kill him directly?

At this time, the desert guard on the city wall suddenly glanced at him lightly.

In an instant, the demon clan leader was stunned on the spot as if he was stabbed by thousands of swords.

And the opponent's cultivation was also known to him at this moment.

The peak of the ninth level of the earth realm!

He had just reached the ninth level of the earth realm.

Can't afford to provoke.

Then he fell from the void obediently.

"Fellow Daoist, are you the Lord of the Wasteland City?"

In front of the city gate, the Demon Clan Chief looked up at the Wasteland Guard and asked politely.

Hearing this, the Wasteland Guard just said lightly: "The Lord is in the City Lord's Mansion, I am just a gatekeeper."

Gatekeeper...

This sentence immediately made the Demon Clan Chief's heart surge again.

A ninth-level gatekeeper in the Earth Realm? !

Is this Wasteland City so awesome?

Then he is not even as good as the gatekeeper of this Wasteland City.

Taking a deep breath, the Demon Clan Chief gave up the purpose of asking for an explanation and turned to congratulating the Wasteland City.

After paying the entrance fee, the Demon Clan Chief hurriedly entered the Wasteland City.

There is a different world in this Wasteland City.

Sure enough, as soon as he entered the Wasteland City, he was shocked again.

But before he could react, countless hateful eyes suddenly looked at him.

Even several big figures in the City Lord's Mansion were the same.

The next moment, Yunqi and Gu Chen suddenly appeared in front of the Demon Clan Chief.

Seeing Yunqi and the others, the Demon Clan Chief understood everything.

This deserted city is really awesome.

At this time, Yunqi looked at the Demon Clan Chief and frowned slightly.

"Evil demon? No."

Hearing this, the Demon Clan Chief hurriedly said: "I am the Demon Clan Chief, and I came to the deserted city to congratulate you. I wonder where your city lord is?"

Demon Clan?

Yunqi and the others looked at each other, and then said: "You want to see the city lord?"

The Demon Clan Chief nodded.

"Then come with me."

Lu Daosheng had already ordered that anyone who reached the ninth level of the Earth Realm could see him.

For those who couldn't reach it, forget it.

After all, he didn't see everyone.

Then, the Demon Clan Chief followed Gu Chen to the inner city.

Along the way, everything he saw was subverting his cognition.

Why is this city so luxurious? It is no exaggeration to say that the foot-washing water in the inner city is better than what he drinks.

At this time, the ancestor of the Phoenix Clan also came to the outside of the deserted city.

This time, he did not come alone.

Beside him, there was a father and daughter.

The woman was Lu Xue's aunt, Yan Luo.

And the middle-aged man was Yan Luo's father, Yan Fengtian.

Not long ago, he just came out of retreat.

When he learned what happened during his recent retreat, he was stunned.

His granddaughter was wanted by the Supreme Elder, and then his son-in-law came to the Phoenix Clan and killed the Supreme Elder.

What is this?

And now, he was asked to follow the Supreme Elder to the human race force founded by his so-called son-in-law.

Originally, he didn't want to come, but he couldn't disobey the order of the ancestor.

But at this moment, when he looked at the huge city in front of him, his heart suddenly floated.

This is definitely a golden son-in-law.

However, whether the other party recognized him or not was still a question, after all, his daughter did not recognize him.

Thinking of this, he could not help shaking his head again.

In the City Lord's Mansion.

"Lord City Lord, the Phoenix Clan's ancestor is here."

In the main hall, An Xing reported to Lu Daosheng.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded.

"Go and call them over."

"Yes, Lord City Lord."

Then An Xing left.

At this time, the Demon Clan Chief, led by Gu Chen, also came to the main hall.

"Lord City Lord."

Lu Daosheng nodded, and then looked at the Demon Clan Chief.

Seeing this, Lu Daosheng was slightly stunned.

This blood, hiss~ Why is it so familiar.

Wait, I remember, this is somewhat similar to the blood of the evil demon clan, and this guy's aura is also very similar to the evil demon clan.

On the side, Gu Chen also looked at the demon clan leader with a puzzled look.

What is the relationship between this guy and the evil demon clan?

At this time, the demon clan leader could not stand the different looks from several people, and took the initiative to say: "Lord Huang, I am the demon clan leader, Han Cheng."

After that, the hall was still quiet.

Han Cheng was a little embarrassed, and then he thought of the evil demon clan that had been destroyed, and he reacted immediately.

"Ahaha, I guess you are very confused, why do I have so many similarities with the evil demon clan."

Han Cheng took the initiative to speak.

Gu Chen and others nodded.

Lu Daosheng had already deduced it secretly at this time.

Oh, that's it.

But you, the demon clan, have suffered this disaster, and you deserve it. Who asked you to create the evil demon clan to harm the world?

At this time, the demon clan leader Han Cheng also explained.

After a long time, Gu Chen and his companions suddenly realized, and their eyes towards Han Cheng were less hostile.

At least it can be confirmed that this guy is really not an evil demon, but he is still related to the evil demon.

Below, Han Cheng looked at Lu Daosheng above, and began to think constantly in his heart.

When did such a strong man appear in the Wanling Realm?

This is probably at least a Heavenly King Realm existence.

This human race’s power is indeed not to be underestimated.

At this time, the ancestor of the Phoenix Clan brought Yan Luo and his daughter to the hall.

Seeing Yan Luo, Lu Daosheng smiled slightly, and as for the remaining two, Lu Daosheng ignored them.

This made the other two very embarrassed.

"Well, I am the current ancestor of the Phoenix Clan, and I came here to congratulate the deserted city today."

"Oh."

Lu Daosheng responded lightly, and then turned his head to look at Yan Luo.

"Yan Luo, are you willing to come to my deserted city?"

Lu Daosheng smiled.

This is her sister-in-law anyway, and she is also very good to her daughter. Last time, he was too angry and forgot about it.

It's not too late to say it now.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's words, Yan Luo nodded without thinking, "Okay."

Just kidding, she has been talking all the way.

She knew that Lu Xue's father would be rich, but she didn't expect him to be so rich.

It is estimated that any piece of this floor tile would be worth a fortune.

Seeing Yan Luo agreed, at Lu Daosheng's signal, a guard took Yan Luo out of the hall.

The Phoenix Clan Ancestor and Yan Fengtian stared at the side.
